Use case: compositing. Asset type: high quality art direction target illustration for a real tactical mecha game, not an actual runtime screenshot.
Input 1 provides ONLY the existing canal bridge battlefield layout and normal isometric camera: walkable industrial service deck in foreground, recessed canal through center with a damaged bridge/rail crossing, modern utility buildings behind it, compact bounded combat board with credible slab thickness and infrastructure depth. Remove ALL HUD, buttons, unit labels, text, health bars, minimaps and UI chrome. Keep this underlying map configuration and camera distance; do not make a completely different city map.
Input 2 is the EXACT allied M01 white/teal/gold robot identity. Place this machine near the left end of the bridge in a mild active fighting stance, retain its head, chest vent pair, shoulder and leg design, no extra backpack or guns. Input 3 is the EXACT indigo/plum mechanical cable-biting beetle enemy. Place two of this enemy type threatening the bridge, each with substantial body mass: shell width roughly 70 to 85 percent of the standing M01's total height, lower center of mass, readable cutting mandibles and legs, not tiny bugs. Keep open maneuvering spaces. Input 4 is the architectural style and form master: a closed-roof SIX-STORY near-future occupied residential refuge apartment, one on the back-right deck, height comparable to slightly taller than standing M01, not a one-story shed. Keep its sand gray structural slabs, deep blue glazing, warm windows and coral entrance accent.
Translate the WHOLE scene to one polished KINETIC_CEL production language: confident dark ink contours with pressure variation; broad painterly colored planes with maximum two hard cel-shadow steps per surface; selective fine panel lines; dimensional recessed drains, raised curbs, material joins, rail grooves and canal retaining-wall depth. NOT a flat printed tile sticker, NOT low-detail primitive blocks. Bright yet comfortable middle-value palette: warm gray/muted limestone deck, blue-green shaded canal, graphite railwork, muted violet-blue utility building panels, restrained ochre safety bands. Preserve M01's own white/teal/gold paint and indigo/plum enemy paint; environment must not recolor all actors as one set. Deep muted-blue empty outside-board background. Separate silhouettes with local value/color grouping, not glowing outlines. Clear calm composition suitable at normal tactical viewing distance, not cinematic close-up or top-down orthographic.
One 16:10 landscape image. No generated text, symbols, numbers, signage, callouts, arrows, chess reticles or interface elements. This is a coherent normal-camera look-development illustration, no collage panels or concept-sheet layout.

Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: single transparent dramatic event cut-in illustration for an existing martial-arts mecha.
The attached image is the exact M01 white/teal/gold hero identity. Keep its same head and antennas, paired gold chest vents with teal central chest, white shoulders/thighs, teal leg inserts, gold forearm/shin edges, graphite articulated joints and black mechanical fists. Do not redesign armor, add weapons, cape or wings. Depict its signature rising sky-punch: planted rear foot pushes power through a visibly coiled pelvis and torso, own RIGHT fist thrusting UPWARD above its own head, right elbow opening, other fist drawn to waist; whole torso opening upward, not a level horizontal jab. Three-quarter low-angle foreshortening, dynamic but mechanically coherent, exactly two arms and two legs, both feet still identifiable, punch hand clearly a closed fist. Strong heroic silhouette, recognizable same machine at every joint.
Polished KINETIC_CEL: thick/thin ink contours, broad teal/ivory/ochre planes, two hard cel shadow levels maximum, high energy from pose and linework. Isolate just the machine, actual fully clear transparent alpha outside its silhouette. NO glow halo, smoke, floor, background, poster shapes, speed lines, text or UI; poster graphics and type will be added separately. Keep all antenna, punching fist, feet inside frame with clear margin.
